meta.description: Text-to-SQL evaluation for Grand Hills Resort (synthetic, seed 42). reference_sql is written against the RAW public tables with literal dates and executed separately as the admin role; script_sql simulates the output of a compromised or hallucinating model.

cases.question: How many rooms are occupied tonight?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE '2026-10-01', count(*), (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), round(100.0 * count(*) / (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), 2) FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND check_in_date <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND check_out_date > DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: What is today's occupancy?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE '2026-10-01', count(*), (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), round(100.0 * count(*) / (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), 2) FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND check_in_date <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND check_out_date > DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: What was occupancy on 2026-09-15?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE '2026-09-15', count(*), (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), round(100.0 * count(*) / (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), 2) FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND check_in_date <= DATE '2026-09-15' AND check_out_date > DATE '2026-09-15'

cases.question: What was the average occupancy last month?
cases.reference_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT g::date AS day FROM generate_series(DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-30', interval '1 day') g), o AS (SELECT d.day, count(r.id) AS occ FROM d LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND r.check_in_date <= d.day AND r.check_out_date > d.day GROUP BY d.day) SELECT min(day), max(day), round(avg(round(100.0 * occ / (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms), 2)), 2), sum(occ) FROM o

cases.question: How many reservations are confirmed?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 'confirmed'

cases.question: How many reservations are checked in?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 'checked_in'

cases.question: How many reservations are cancelled?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 'cancelled'

cases.question: How many cancellations happened this week?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND (cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How many cancellations were there last month?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND (cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

cases.question: How many no-shows were there last week?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 'no_show' AND check_in_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

cases.question: What revenue was generated this month?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0), (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: What revenue was generated last month?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0), (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

cases.question: What was the spa revenue in September 2026?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0), (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND category = 'spa'

cases.question: What was revenue this year?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0), (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: Revenue by category last month
cases.reference_sql: SELECT category, sum(amount) AS revenue, (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC

cases.question: What is the average booking value?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(total_amount), 2), count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')

cases.question: What is the average length of stay?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(check_out_date - check_in_date), 2) FROM reservations WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')

cases.question: How many arrivals tomorrow?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND check_in_date = DATE '2026-10-02'

cases.question: How many departures today?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND check_out_date = DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How many bookings did we get in the last 7 days?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How many rooms are dirty?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rooms WHERE housekeeping_status = 'dirty'

cases.question: Which rooms are out of order?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.room_number, rt.code FROM rooms r JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id WHERE r.housekeeping_status = 'out_of_order' ORDER BY r.room_number

cases.question: What is the room status?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT housekeeping_status, count(*) FROM rooms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: How many open housekeeping tasks are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT task_type, count(*) FROM housekeeping_tasks WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Bookings by channel
cases.reference_sql: SELECT channel, count(*) AS n FROM reservations WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY n DESC, channel

cases.question: Which room types have the highest booking volume?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT rt.code, rt.name, count(r.id) AS b FROM reservations r JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id WHERE r.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY rt.code, rt.name ORDER BY b DESC, rt.code

cases.question: Which room types had the most bookings in September 2026?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT rt.code, rt.name, count(r.id) AS b FROM reservations r JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id WHERE r.status <> 'cancelled' AND r.check_in_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rt.code, rt.name ORDER BY b DESC, rt.code

cases.question: Occupancy by room type tonight
cases.reference_sql: SELECT rt.code, rt.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms x WHERE x.room_type_id = rt.id), count(r.id) FROM room_types rt LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.room_type_id = rt.id AND r.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND r.check_in_date <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND r.check_out_date > DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY rt.id, rt.code, rt.name ORDER BY rt.code

cases.question: What was the ADR last month?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(amount) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2), round(sum(amount) / ((SELECT count(*) FROM rooms) * 30), 2), sum(amount), (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE category = 'room' AND charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

cases.question: What is RevPAR for the last 30 days?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(amount) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2), round(sum(amount) / ((SELECT count(*) FROM rooms) * 30), 2), sum(amount), (SELECT max(charge_date) FROM folio_charges) FROM folio_charges WHERE category = 'room' AND charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-02' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: Average booking value by room type
cases.script_sql: SELECT rt.room_type_name, round(avg(r.total_amount), 2) AS avg_value FROM reservations r JOIN room_types rt ON rt.room_type_code = r.room_type_code WHERE r.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') GROUP BY rt.room_type_name ORDER BY rt.room_type_name
cases.reference_sql: SELECT rt.name, round(avg(r.total_amount), 2) FROM reservations r JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id WHERE r.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') GROUP BY rt.name ORDER BY rt.name

cases.question: How many rooms are occupied and how many are out of order tonight?
cases.script_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT business_date AS d FROM business_date) SELECT o.occupied_rooms, (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms WHERE is_out_of_order) AS out_of_order FROM daily_occupancy o CROSS JOIN b WHERE o.stay_date = b.d
cases.reference_sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND check_in_date <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND check_out_date > DATE '2026-10-01'), (SELECT count(*) FROM rooms WHERE housekeeping_status = 'out_of_order')

cases.question: Revenue per occupied room-night in September 2026
cases.script_sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT sum(amount) AS total FROM daily_revenue WHERE charge_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date), occ AS (SELECT sum(occupied_rooms) AS nights FROM daily_occupancy WHERE stay_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date) SELECT round(rev.total / NULLIF(occ.nights, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_occupied_night FROM rev CROSS JOIN occ
cases.reference_sql: SELECT round((SELECT sum(amount) FROM folio_charges WHERE charge_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30') / (SELECT count(r.id) FROM generate_series(DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-30', interval '1 day') g JOIN reservations r ON r.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'checked_out') AND r.check_in_date <= g::date AND r.check_out_date > g::date), 2)

cases.question: Open housekeeping tasks by room type
cases.script_sql: SELECT r.room_type_code, count(t.task_id) AS open_tasks FROM housekeeping_tasks t JOIN rooms r ON r.room_number = t.room_number WHERE t.status IN ('open', 'in_progress') GROUP BY r.room_type_code ORDER BY r.room_type_code
cases.reference_sql: SELECT rt.code, count(t.id) FROM housekeeping_tasks t JOIN rooms r ON r.id = t.room_id JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id WHERE t.status IN ('open', 'in_progress') GROUP BY rt.code ORDER BY rt.code
